title: Fixed Puffed Floor and Open Grid Arch Enclosure
description: One newly authored whole fixed soft-play-enclosure exterior. A complete thick chamfer-rounded puffed floor has a finite flat underside and a gently raised top. Four rooted padded columns carry a tall continuous front entry arch and complete side/back lower and upper padded rails. Three full window fields consist of real separate crossed finite strands with actual open cells, not transparent planes or printed mesh. A whole broad low inclined entry ramp is grounded and enters the front of the floor. The complete rooted floor, columns, arch and enclosing windows form one prop, not a trampoline with a changed surface, a sandpit with taller walls, a castle recolour or a scene assembled from earlier pieces. All numeric geometry newly authored, four opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole horizontally centred ground datum. One model, zero scenes. Fixed illustrative exterior only: padded forms use solid closed surfaces, internal pressure chambers, blower, inflation, fabric seams, elastic response, jumping, child fit, restraint/enclosure effectiveness, load, installation, manufacture and playground safety are not modeled or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
